stemMd: What is sin(π − θ) in terms of sin θ?
explanationMd: Supplementary angles have the same vertical coordinate on the unit circle. Therefore sin(π−θ)=sinθ. Their cosines have opposite signs, but their sines agree.

distractorRationale.e: That sign applies to sin(−θ), not this supplementary angle.
distractorRationale.a: This is a cofunction relation for a different angle.
distractorRationale.d: This is not the supplementary sine identity.
distractorRationale.c: Sine does not distribute over angle subtraction in this way.
